Use case: precise-object-edit. The supplied image is the exact own repair-1 poster. Make one final independent flat opaque square poster; all literal copy and conditions above are binding.

Width:height 1:1.

Edit TWO observed remaining relationships:
1. SURFACE DENSITY: The central recovering purple dome is covered by many tiny irregular scratches/squiggles. Replace that dense texture specifically on the broad upper-center rounded dome with largely calm matte handworked clay. Use a few broad faint rubbing traces that follow the curvature, with no repeating marks and no shiny surface. Keep tactile modeling-clay softness and broad diffuse shading. Compression evidence is concentrated in the concave left/right finger hollows, their folded rims, and the flattened widened base: retain denser soft local creases there. This local variation must describe compression versus recovery. The purple object must still be clay, not smooth plastic, a balloon or liquid.
2. ARMS DEFINE THE INFORMATION OPENING: Existing hands and their fingers remain beside the central mass with the same clear release gaps. Lengthen/re-angle their attached forearms so they come from BOTH LOWER CORNERS and rise along the outer side margins. The forearms occupy roughly x0–13% on the left and x87–100% on the right, continuing down to y96–100%, and attach naturally to the existing palms above. These two sloping forearms frame the FULL central participation information group, not just the event-name line. Keep the central x17–83%, y65–96% space open and wide for existing readable copy; no text overlap, no thinner/compressed text. Fingers remain withdrawn outward from matching imprints and do not touch or cradle the blob. Keep coherent five-finger clay anatomy.

Strictly preserve the prior poster's observed advantages: one large continuous matte bright-purple mass with substantial rounded recovering dome and still wide squashed base; broad concave side pressure imprints; clean yellow release gaps between both hands and clay; saturated yellow/purple complementary contrast; subdued peach hands; upper-left broad soft light; clear natural shadow direction; all six exact copy entries each once; thick raised legible purple Korean title in one centered line above the body; shallower raised information grouped in the wide middle lower opening, event line then action line then date/time then venue then application URL. Keep text fronts facing viewer, normal syllable and Latin proportions, open Hangul counters, ordinary word spacing, single-line date/time and URL, unclipped edges and safe margins. Preserve actual readable text instead of redrawing approximate substitutes.

Do not change wording or add text/logo/labels, arrows, confetti, decorations, extra objects, extra clay blobs, frames or panels. Do not turn side hollows into detached tubes, cut-through holes, or separated before/after forms. Only calm the recovering dome surface and bring the attached forearms to the lower corners to frame information. One flat full-bleed opaque poster, no mockup.

Matte purple/yellow complement, peach clay hands and consistent upper-left light.
